Packaging claim: A U.S. Shelf Price May Exclude Sales Tax
Core fact: Washington permits retailers to advertise a tax-included price only when that inclusion is clearly stated.
Second reveal: When tax is excluded from the displayed price, sales tax can be added at the register.
First frame: show a shelf tag and a higher register total immediately, large and recognizable. Animate the physical change or causal chain without invented labels or unsupported details. Tell points or reacts without covering the object.
Fact boundaries: Tax rules differ by state, product and retailer; use Washington as a concrete example rather than saying all U.S. prices work this way.
